policies.decision: A projection request is eligible only when its selector and Context Projection Binding are registered, version-exact, current, and owner-routed.
collect_all_checks: projection profile and cut policy are registered
policies.owner_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner

policies.decision: Deliver a projection only after every selector, cut, event-chain, governance-join, subject, relation, profile, and digest obligation passes.
collect_all_checks: same exact inputs satisfy determinism evidence when runtime evidence exists
policies.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus runtime and integration conformance owners

policies.decision: A valid unresolved load-bearing challenge blocks only the explicitly dependent reading or D65 successor until its owner gate resolves or records typed residue.
policies.owner_route: challenged subject owner plus business-ontology owner
policies.challenge_route: Challenged subject owner at its named gate
